import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    
    # Allocate SBUF tile for input
    input_tile = nl.ndarray((C, H, W), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=input_tile, src=x)
    
    # Create strided view for pooling
    view = input_tile.ap([[0, C], [0, H // p * p], [0, W // p * p]])
    view = view.reshape(C, H // p, p, W // p, p)
    
    # Sum over the last two axes
    sum_tile = nl.ndarray(view.shape, dtype=view.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nl.sum(view, axis=[3, 4], dst=sum_tile)
    
    # Scale by 1/(p*p)
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=sum_tile, data=1.0 / (p * p), op0=nisa.multiply)
    
    # Allocate output in shared HBM
    output = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=sum_tile.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=output, src=sum_tile)
    
    return output

The pairs after it walk inside one partition, in elements: one image row is W elements, one column is 1.
